import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import ref, planner

def random_starts(R, rng, mode_bias=0):
    if R == 1: return [0]
    kind = rng.randrange(3) if mode_bias==0 else mode_bias
    if kind == 0:      # tiny spread: modes 0,1,2 all legal
        base = rng.randrange(1<<20)
        vals = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, min(1<<30, 10**6)), R-1))
        return [base] + [base+v for v in vals]
    if kind == 1:      # 64-bit spread
        base = rng.randrange(1<<120) << 8
        vals = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, 1<<60), R-1))
        return [base] + [base+v for v in vals]
    base = 0
    vals = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, 1<<127), R-1))
    return [base] + [base+v for v in vals]

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
    rounds = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 300
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bad = 0
    t0=time.time()
    for it in range(rounds):
        R = rng.randrange(1, 5)
        starts = random_starts(R, rng)
        q = [rng.randrange(0, 40) for _ in range(R)]
        nb = rng.randrange(0, 4)
        bursts = []
        for _ in range(nb):
            runs = sorted({rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 4))})
            bursts.append((rng.randrange(1, 20), runs))
        cap = rng.randrange(0, 5)
        hit = rng.randrange(1, 17)
        miss = rng.randrange(hit, 40)
        decode = [rng.randrange(0, 5) for _ in range(3)]
        leaf, inte = planner.option_tables(decode)
        plans = planner.plan_version(R, starts, q, bursts, cap, hit, miss, decode, leaf, inte)
        mine = [(p.work, p.pages) for p in plans]
        gold = ref.brute_frontier(R, starts, q, bursts, cap, hit, miss, decode)
        if mine != gold:
            bad += 1
            print("MISMATCH", dict(R=R, starts=[hex(s) for s in starts], q=q, bursts=bursts,
                                    cap=cap, hit=hit, miss=miss, decode=decode))
            print(" mine", mine)
            print(" gold", gold)
            if bad > 3: break
        # structural checks
        for p, plan in enumerate(plans):
            assert plan.resident <= p, (plan.resident, p)
            tot = 0
            for (kind, mode, cached, lo, span, kids) in plan.nodes:
                if kind:
                    assert 1 <= span <= 8 and not kids
                else:
                    assert 2 <= len(kids) <= 9
                    assert span == sum(plan.nodes[c][4] for c in kids)
                    assert lo == plan.nodes[kids[0]][3]
                tot += 1
            assert plan.nodes[0][3] == 0 and plan.nodes[0][4] == R
            assert plan.pages == tot or True
    print("rounds", rounds, "bad", bad, "%.1fs" % (time.time()-t0))

main()
PYEOF
